name: 3M Littmann Classic III Stethoscope, Pearl Pink
seoTitle: Pearl Pink Littmann Classic III Stethoscope
metaDescription: The Littmann Classic III stethoscope in pearl pink with a stainless steel chestpiece. A soft, pretty gift for nursing students, new grads, and pink lovers.
summary: A Littmann Classic III with a soft pearl pink tube, a pretty and practical gift for a nurse who loves a little color.
whyItWorks: Pink stethoscopes have a loyal following among nurses, and pearl pink is a gentle, pretty shade that still looks polished at work. It stands out among the black and navy models at the nurses station, which is handy when a dozen stethoscopes get set down in the same spot. For someone who already has pink scrubs or a pink badge reel, it ties the whole look together.

Underneath the color, it is a Classic III, one of the most familiar stethoscopes in nursing, with a stainless steel chestpiece noted in the title. That makes it a natural gift for a pinning ceremony, graduation, or first nursing job, and a sweet Mother's Day or birthday surprise for a nurse mom. It is also a nice way to replace a worn out stethoscope from school with something that feels a little more grown up. Add a card and a stethoscope name tag, and you have a gift that gets used every single shift.
goodToKnow: Confirm the tube length on the listing, since the title's measurement uses an unusual format.
Pearl pink is soft, so check the listing photos to make sure it is the shade you have in mind.
Pair with a matching pink badge reel for a coordinated gift.

faq.q: Is pink too bold for a professional setting?
faq.a: Not usually. Colored stethoscopes are common on most units, and pearl pink is a soft shade rather than a loud one.

faq.q: Is this a good pinning ceremony gift?
faq.a: Yes. The Classic III is a classic choice for new nurses, and the pink color makes it feel personal.
